setting: You all work at a small bakery in Perth, Western Australia, on one rotating roster. You know each other from shifts, early starts, and close-quarters cleanup, so you know who is reliable, who swaps shifts often, and roughly what each other's life looks like outside work.
opener: Ask who can cover Saturday's early start, since Tom has already swapped twice.

Mia.knows: You've worked with Priya for years and trust her with the business side. You know Liam is good on the counter but still learning the ovens. You know Tom is young and keen, and you've had to remind him about shift times more than once.
Mia.like: You're organised and direct, and you say what needs doing and then move on.
Mia.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly when a shift or a bake needs sorting.
Mia.style: You use almost no emoji and few abbreviations.

Liam.knows: You know Mia runs the kitchen tightly and Priya owns the shop. You know Priya is fair but busy. You know Tom is a good mate who sometimes forgets his lanyard.
Liam.like: You're easygoing and chatty, and you take things as they come.
Liam.texts: You message the group now and then, usually to swap shifts or share a laugh.
Liam.style: You use a few emoji and the occasional casual abbreviation.

Priya.knows: You know Mia is your most skilled baker and keeps the production running. You know Liam is dependable on the counter and good with customers. You know Tom is still finding his feet, so you keep an eye on him.
Priya.like: You're capable and steady, and you carry more than you let on.
Priya.texts: You message the group now and then, mostly to update the roster or pass on orders.
Priya.style: You use almost no emoji and no abbreviations.

Tom.knows: You know Mia is strict but fair and that she's the one who taught you to shape dough. You know Liam is a laugh and always has a story. You know Priya is the boss and is generous with shifts when you ask nicely.
Tom.like: You're enthusiastic and a bit scatterbrained, and you want everyone to like you.
Tom.texts: You message the group rarely, usually only to swap a shift or reply to someone.
Tom.style: You use a few emoji and some casual abbreviations like "ya" and "lol".

private_lines.Mia: You rent a small flat in Mount Lawley and live alone. You start the ovens around 4am most weekdays and finish by early afternoon, so your evenings are quiet and your days are early.
private_lines.Liam: You share a house in Leederville with housemates who aren't in this chat. You work mostly morning and midday counter shifts, and on some nights you pick up bar work, so your days start late and run into the evening.
private_lines.Priya: You own the bakery and live alone in Subiaco. You open the shop most days and handle orders, payroll, and suppliers, so your days start before dawn and end late with paperwork.
private_lines.Tom: You live with your parents in Balcatta and study part-time at TAFE. You work weekend early starts at the bakery and a couple of weekday afternoons, so your sleep is late and your mornings are rushed.
